posts.text: BusinessLine – 8 Oct 26 Groww leads NSE client additions with 48% share in Q2 FY27 Brokerage platform Groww added 1,01,000 active clients in September, accounting for nearly 63% of the broking industry’s net additions of around 161,000 during the month, according to NSE data. Groww adds over 1 lakh active clients in September
